Exploration Technology's FY2019/FY2020 values don't match either candidate parent account's own figures for the same cells, and Exploration prints blank in exactly those cells -- consistent with, but not proof of, a consolidation. Needs confirmation from a document describing the FY2019 budget request's structural changes before this can be asserted with any confidence.
